content: A team member celebrating their five-year anniversary has the option of receiving a GitLab branded computer backpack [1].

messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [New Hires, Celebrations and Significant Life Events > New Hire Swag > Celebrations > GitLab Anniversary > Anniversary Gifts]
Team members celebrating a GitLab anniversary will have the option to select a custom swag item only available to those celebrating an anniversary. Team members celebrating their one-year anniversary have the option to receive a custom GitLab Tech-Caddy. Those celebrating their three-year anniversary have the option of a branded 3-piece tumbler, pen and notebook set. Folks celebrating their five-year anniversary have the option of a GitLab branded computer backpack. And finally, team members celebrating their tenth-year anniversary have the option of receiving a custom swag package.

No action is required by team members in order to receive these gifts! If you are due an anniversary gift the vendor team, Brilliant, will email you on the day of your anniversary with a specific redemption link. The People Operations team runs a monthly report from Workday during the first week of the new month looking back to the previous month to audit the eligible team members and makes sure all emails were sent out.

[2] [New Hires, Celebrations and Significant Life Events > New Hire Swag > Celebrations > GitLab Anniversary]
At GitLab we like to acknowledge and celebrate team member milestones and contributions. This means that those celebrating their first, third, fifth and tenth hire-date anniversary will receive a token of acknowledgement.

Along with this, all celebrants regardless of length of tenure will receive a mention in the **#team-member-updates** channel which allows the greater GitLab community to share in the celebration!

[3] [New Hires, Celebrations and Significant Life Events > New Hire Swag > Celebrations > GitLab Anniversary > Redeeming New Hire Swag and Anniversary Swag]
Please note: the New Hire and Anniversary Swag links are provided specifically for the redemption of preselected items. These items are not eligible for exchange or conversion to swag shop credit.

If you have any questions or need further assistance regarding New Hire or Anniversary Swag, please don't hesitate to reach out to the People Operations team through [Compass](https://app.serval.com/new-request).

Question: What swag item can a GitLab employee receive on their five‑year anniversary?
